name: AutoCloseOnProfitLoss
summary: This EA monitors the total floating profit/loss of all open positions and automatically closes all positions when either a target profit or maximum loss threshold is reached. It serves as an account-level profit/loss manager that acts as a global take-profit and stop-loss for the entire portfolio.
summary_zh: 该EA监控所有持仓的浮动盈亏总和，当达到目标盈利或最大亏损阈值时自动平掉所有仓位。它作为账户级别的盈亏管理工具，相当于整个投资组合的全局止盈和止损。
strategy_analysis: 该EA本质上是一个账户级别的盈亏管理工具，不涉及任何入场策略或开仓逻辑。它的核心概念是监控所有持仓的累计浮动盈亏，当总盈利达到目标值或总亏损达到最大容忍值时，执行全仓平仓操作。入场条件完全由用户或其他EA决定，本EA不负责开仓。出场条件为：总盈利≥TargetProfit时平所有仓位，或总亏损≤MaxLoss时平所有仓位。仓位管理方面，该EA不进行任何仓位计算或调整，仅负责平仓。资金管理方面，通过TargetProfit和MaxLoss两个参数实现账户级别的止盈止损控制，但缺少对单笔仓位的风险隔离机制。策略逻辑简单直接，适合作为辅助工具配合其他交易EA使用。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is essentially an account-level profit/loss management utility that does not involve any entry strategy or position-opening logic. Its core concept is to monitor the cumulative floating profit/loss of all positions, and when total profit reaches the target or total loss hits the maximum tolerance, it closes all positions. Entry conditions are entirely determined by the user or other EAs; this EA does not open positions. Exit conditions are: close all positions when total profit >= TargetProfit, or close all positions when total loss <= MaxLoss. Regarding position sizing, the EA does not perform any lot calculation or adjustment—it only handles closing. For money management, it implements account-level take-profit and stop-loss control via the TargetProfit and MaxLoss parameters, but lacks risk isolation for individual positions. The strategy logic is simple and direct, making it suitable as a supplementary tool alongside other trading EAs.

parameters.name: TargetProfit
parameters.description: 目标盈利金额（账户货币单位），达到时平所有仓位
parameters.description_en: Target profit amount (account currency), closes all positions when reached

parameters.name: MaxLoss
parameters.description: 最大亏损金额（账户货币单位，负值），达到时平所有仓位

parameters.name: EnableProfitClose
parameters.description: 是否启用达到目标盈利时自动平仓
parameters.description_en: Enable auto close on target profit reached

parameters.name: EnableLossClose
parameters.description: 是否启用达到最大亏损时自动平仓
parameters.description_en: Enable auto close on maximum loss reached

parameters.name: ShowAlerts
parameters.description: 是否在平仓时显示弹窗警报
parameters.description_en: Whether to show popup alerts on position close

pros: 逻辑简单明了，易于理解和使用，适合新手交易者
提供账户级别的全局止盈止损，有效防止过度亏损或贪婪持仓
支持独立开关盈利平仓和亏损平仓功能，灵活度高
使用CTrade类进行平仓操作，符合MQL5标准编程规范
输入参数验证完善，防止用户输入错误参数导致异常行为
pros_en: Simple and clear logic, easy to understand and use, suitable for novice traders
Provides account-level global take-profit and stop-loss, effectively preventing excessive losses or greedy holding
Supports independent toggle for profit-close and loss-close functions, offering high flexibility
Uses the CTrade class for closing operations, following MQL5 standard programming conventions
Thorough input parameter validation prevents abnormal behavior from incorrect user input
cons: 每个tick都计算总盈亏并打印日志，会造成大量冗余日志输出，影响性能和日志可读性
平仓时没有重试机制，网络延迟或市场剧烈波动时可能平仓失败且不重试
没有考虑手续费和掉期成本，仅基于浮动盈亏计算可能导致实际平仓结果与预期不符
CloseAllPositions函数在循环中只遍历一次，如果部分平仓失败，不会再次尝试关闭剩余仓位
缺少对特定交易品种或魔术号码的过滤，会平掉所有仓位包括其他EA的仓位
cons_en: Calculates total profit/loss and prints logs on every tick, causing massive redundant log output that impacts performance and log readability
No retry mechanism for closing positions; closing may fail without retries during network latency or extreme market volatility
Does not account for commissions and swap costs; relying solely on floating P&L may cause actual closing results to differ from expectations
CloseAllPositions only loops once; if some positions fail to close, it does not retry closing remaining positions
Lacks filtering by specific symbol or magic number, which will close all positions including those from other EAs
improvements: 增加按品种、魔术号码过滤的功能，避免误关其他EA的仓位
改为按新K线或定时器触发计算，减少tick级别的冗余日志和计算开销
增加平仓重试机制和失败后的延迟重试逻辑，提高平仓成功率
在盈亏计算中加入手续费和掉期成本，使总盈亏更接近实际账户变动
增加只平盈利仓位或只平亏损仓位的选择功能，提供更灵活的资金管理策略
improvements_en: Add filtering by symbol and magic number to avoid accidentally closing positions from other EAs
Switch to new bar or timer-based triggering instead of every tick to reduce redundant logging and computation overhead
Add a retry mechanism with delayed retries for failed closing attempts to improve closing success rate
Include commissions and swap costs in the profit/loss calculation to make total P&L closer to actual account changes
Add option to close only profitable or only losing positions for more flexible money management strategies

risk_points: 每个tick打印日志会严重影响性能并产生大量冗余日志，在高速行情中可能导致延迟
平仓无重试机制，极端行情下可能出现部分仓位未能及时平掉的风险
无魔术号码过滤会平掉所有EA的仓位，可能与其它策略产生冲突
risk_points_en: Printing logs on every tick can seriously impact performance and generate massive redundant logs, potentially causing delays during fast market conditions
No retry mechanism for closing means some positions may not be closed in time during extreme market conditions
No magic number filtering will close positions from all EAs, potentially conflicting with other strategies

It serves as an account-level profit/loss manager that acts as a global take-profit and stop-loss for the entire portfolio.
